limitations: Applies to two-sided Sturmian shifts of irrational slope. No general extension to arbitrary minimal symbolic systems, no uniform constants near rational slopes, no result on the ordinary topological entropy of the full hyperspace. Independent validation and comprehensive historical-priority assessment have not been performed.
scientific_integrity: An analytic all-irrational proof is included; the exact-rational code verifies finite consistency only and is not presented as an infinite proof.
title: Exact polynomial-entropy hierarchy for finite subsets of every Sturmian shift
